evidence: Dropdown submenus open on CSS :hover only; pressing Tab jumps past child navigation items.
user_impact: Keyboard-only and switch-control users cannot navigate to internal services or child pages.
recommended_fix: Add aria-expanded and toggle visibility with keyboard listeners (Enter/Space and Escape).

evidence: Text inputs rely solely on visual placeholders with no associated <label> elements.
user_impact: Screen reader users receive no announcements and lose field context when typing.
recommended_fix: Add explicit <label for="inputId"> elements for all input elements.

evidence: White text #FFFFFF on light green #7ED321 produces a 2.1:1 contrast ratio (minimum required is 4.5:1).
user_impact: Users with low vision or high glare cannot distinguish text labels on primary action buttons.
recommended_fix: Update brand accent to #0B572B or darker to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast against #FFFFFF.

evidence: No "Skip to content" link exists; keyboard users must tab through 25+ top-nav links on every route.
user_impact: Causes severe navigation fatigue for keyboard and assistive device users.
recommended_fix: Inject an accessible skip link (Skip to main content) as the first body child.

evidence: Announcement infographic image has no alt attribute ().
user_impact: Screen reader users are announced "image" with no indication of critical civic announcements.
recommended_fix: Add informative alt text describing the bulletin or mark decorative graphics with alt="".
